items.meaning: Caller-owned set of dependency-satisfied ReadOps not yet handed to the context: exact count, member order, group (refill-burst) boundary. Unit: items per presentation.

items.update_events: window fill/resize, per settled request, refill granularity choice

items.decision_site: PRODUCT submit decision is per-item at ctx.submit_read; the set never exists as one object. R3: decision at adapter submit sees ready.size()
items.consistency: exact within the caller thread; no cross-thread exposure
items.access_cost: free for the caller; invisible to the library unless a batch entry presents it
items.semantic_limit: presentation shape is a caller policy; readiness of an op means caller dependency satisfied, not admission granted

pipeline_census_check.claim: Per-request stage decomposition is exactly tracked by distinct authorities; none is interchangeable
pipeline_census_check.exclusivity: accepted-side stages are mutually exclusive per request at rest and sum to core accepted_live while in flight; dimensions may coexist transiently during transitions guarded by locks; SQ-free/core-slots/config-depth/inflight/device-capacity are four distinct quantities
